news.title: Democrats win control of both the House and Senate in U.S. midterms
news.summary: Democrats flipped the Senate, including Maine where Troy Jackson beat Susan Collins, and took the House with gains across several states. Hakeem Jeffries is in line to become Speaker in January.

news.title: Carney government tables its 2026 federal budget today
news.summary: Finance Minister François-Philippe Champagne's budget, the first under a Liberal majority, is expected to focus on diversifying away from the U.S., defence spending and a West Coast pipeline, with a goal of $1 trillion in foreign investment.

news.title: Russian strike on Ukrainian aid centre kills 33, dozens feared trapped
news.summary: Zelenskyy said a strike on a former school used for aid distribution in Komyshuvakha killed 33, with more than 50 possibly under rubble. U.S.-Russia-Ukraine talks are set for Abu Dhabi on Nov. 10-11.

news.title: Dow soars 1,569 points as Wall Street cheers midterm results
news.summary: The Dow jumped 3.03% to 53,356, the S&P 500 rose 1.59% to 7,689 and the Nasdaq gained 1.44% to 25,737 as investors welcomed divided government and falling oil prices.

news.title: OpenAI pledges to pay data centre power costs after voters push back on AI
news.summary: OpenAI's new community compact commits it to cover full power costs, publish construction plans and drop NDAs with officials, after voters backed AI restrictions in all but one of 41 local ballot measures.

news.title: Melania Trump to host Ukrainian and Russian officials at White House
news.summary: The first lady, who brokered a local truce in Ukraine's Kherson region in October, is meeting rights ombudsmen from both countries ahead of next week's trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi.

news.title: Canada and China extend canola-for-steel trade deal to end of 2028
news.summary: The January deal that cut Chinese tariffs on canola meal, peas and seafood was extended two years; canola seed exports rose 84% to $1.91 billion over the comparable period.

news.title: WHO backs trials of two vaccines against record Ebola outbreak
news.summary: Oxford/Serum Institute and Moderna candidates will be trialled against the Bundibugyo strain, which has infected over 10,000 people and killed more than 5,300, mostly in the DRC.

news.title: Eurozone inflation climbs to 4%, highest in three years
news.summary: October inflation rose from 3.8% as energy prices jumped 20.8% year on year, while core inflation held at 2.5%; markets see an 84% chance of an ECB hike in December.

news.title: Israel's president opens coalition talks after inconclusive election
news.summary: President Isaac Herzog accepted certified results from the Oct. 27 vote, in which neither Netanyahu's bloc nor Gadi Eisenkot's won a majority, and began consultations with parties.

news.title: AMD to pay $2.9 billion for Toronto AI chip startup Taalas
news.summary: A securities filing priced the cash-and-stock deal at about US$2.9 billion, with US$1.4 billion contingent, making it one of the largest Canadian tech takeovers.

news.title: Canada's U.S. trade focus 'hasn't changed' after midterms, LeBlanc says
news.summary: Trade Minister Dominic LeBlanc said Ottawa will keep working with the current Congress until January while diversifying trade partners.

news.title: Cristiano Ronaldo retires from international football
news.summary: The 41-year-old ends a 23-year Portugal career as the men's all-time top international scorer with 146 goals in 234 games; he will keep playing for Al-Nassr.

news.title: CVS to split into two companies, unwinding Aetna merger
news.summary: CVS Health will separate its roughly 9,000 retail pharmacies from its insurance and PBM business by early 2028; shares fell more than 10% despite Q3 sales of $108.4 billion.

news.title: Google faces backlash over plan to cut Search for schools refusing AI
news.summary: Lawmakers and educators criticized Google's plan to turn off Search for K-12 schools that don't opt in to its AI tools; Google says Gemini will now be off by default.

news.title: Joshua Wong sentenced to 10 more years in Hong Kong
news.summary: The pro-democracy activist, due for release in January, was sentenced under the national security law for colluding with foreign forces and now faces prison until late 2036.

news.title: Mother and daughter believed killed in grizzly attack near Bella Coola
news.summary: Remains of two women were found Monday and Tuesday near the Snooka West Trail in B.C.; conservation officers are searching for the bears involved.

news.title: Meta acquires AI coding startup Conductor
news.summary: Conductor, which runs multiple coding agents in parallel workspaces, is joining Meta for undisclosed terms; its cloud service shuts down Nov. 20.

news.title: China threatens retaliation as EU readies trade 'kill-switch'
news.summary: Beijing's EU envoy warned of countermeasures as Brussels prepares a tool to curb Chinese market access amid a trade deficit of about €1 billion a day.
